data.narrative:
Limelight Steel is a pre-seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Olivia Dippo and Andy Zhao that has raised $6M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, peer-median valuation methods proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set; only three or more datapoints in filtered cohorts would support reliable median benchmarking.

A stage-progression methodology is applicable here. Using total capital raised ($6M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of pre-seed to next-stage progressions yields an implied valuation of $15M. This represents the primary quantitative anchor in the absence of sufficient peer-stage data.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $13M to $17M, centered on a $15M median derived from stage-progression mechanics alone. Key uncertainties include the absence of verifiable peer comparables at identical stages and the limited precision inherent in single-method triangulation. Additional valuation texture would require either tighter peer-stage alignment or disclosure of Limelight's operating metrics (burn rate, technical milestones, market addressability). The $15M figure should be treated as a provisional floor pending access to more granular comparable company or transaction data.
